Small Memory, clear control

Add names, projects, and terms by hand, review suggestions from pasted text, or confirm a correction after dictation. Edit or delete saved items whenever you need.

Choose how your microphone is processed

Settings → Audio includes optional Apple voice processing, off by default. Noise reduction, echo cancellation, and automatic gain control run on your Mac before audio goes to Qwen. Soft speech and whispers may be affected; turn it off if words are missed. This does not identify your voice or guarantee that other speakers are removed.

Free app, your own model account

SayKuku is free. Its source is available on GitHub under Apache 2.0. It uses Qwen3.8 Omni Flash models to work directly with audio, rather than a fixed ASR-then-LLM pipeline. The current build uses Qwen cloud processing for voice input and Voice Agent. Audio and the context you allow are sent to your selected region. History, Memory, and optional recordings are saved in the app’s Application Support folder on your Mac; your API key is stored in macOS Keychain. Model use may incur charges.

Download the signed and notarized Mac app on the download page. The interactive demo on the Chinese home page uses preset text and does not access the microphone or call a model.
